announce.neroevents.skipped.no_storm_var: [Event] %s has no storm for that place and was skipped.
announce.neroevents.skipped.not_space: [Event] %s can only happen in space and was skipped.
announce.neroevents.skipped.storm_active: [Event] %s was skipped: a storm is already raging there.
event.neroevents.cryo_blizzard.announce: A cryo blizzard reaches %1$s in about %2$s min. Get indoors before you freeze.
event.neroevents.cryo_blizzard.title: Cryo Blizzard
event.neroevents.cryo_blizzard.what_to_d: Get under a solid roof or into a pressurised room. Out in the open you freeze. Glass roofs do not count.
event.neroevents.dust_storm.announce: A dust storm reaches %1$s in about %2$s min. You will not see far.
event.neroevents.dust_storm.title: Dust Storm
event.neroevents.dust_storm.what_to_do: Get under a solid roof or into a pressurised room. Out in the open the dust slows you down. Glass roofs do not count.
event.neroevents.ion_squall.announce: An ion squall reaches %1$s in about %2$s min. Exposed machines will lose power.
event.neroevents.ion_squall.title: Ion Squall
event.neroevents.ion_squall.what_to_do: Get under a solid roof or into a pressurised room, and roof over your batteries. Glass roofs do not count.
event.neroevents.solar_storm.announce: A solar storm reaches %1$s in about %2$s min. Exposed machines will lose power.
event.neroevents.solar_storm.title: Solar Storm
event.neroevents.solar_storm.what_to_do: Get under a solid roof or into a pressurised room, and roof over your batteries. Breathable air is no shelter; glass roofs do not count.
